title: Finiteness theorems for pseudo-coherent complexes on algebraic stacks
summary: Let $f\colon X \to Y$ be a proper and tame morphism of algebraic stacks, where $X$ and $Y$ are locally of finite type over an algebraic stack $S$. We prove that $R f_*$ sends complexes that are pseudo-coherent relative to $S$ to pseudo-coherent complexes relative to $S$. In the scheme case, this resolves a conjecture of Illusie from SGA6. We also prove related and new results in the non-tame setting (e.g., infinite stabilizers).
